brief: Lantern Staffing (fictional sample): offshore staffing for US and UK companies since 2016. 1,100 staff in Ho Chi Minh City, Da Nang, Manila and Cebu. Roles: customer support, bookkeeping, sales support, software QA. Clients save up to 60% against local hiring. Teams start in 3-4 weeks. Staff work in Zendesk, Intercom, Freshdesk, Salesforce, HubSpot, Aircall, Xero, QuickBooks, Jira, Slack, Microsoft Teams and Google Workspace. Awards: Clutch Top BPO Company 2025, Great Place to Work certified 2025, IAOP Global Outsourcing 100 in 2024. Clutch rating 4.9 out of 5 from 86 reviews. ISO 27001 certified offices. Phones: Vietnam (+84) 28 5555 0110, Philippines (+63) 2 5555 0110. Leadership: Margaret Hale (CEO), Andre Wallace (COO), Liza Santos (Head of People), Richard Lowe (Head of Delivery). 45 open positions.

items.a: Lantern Staffing is the legal employer in Vietnam and the Philippines. We run payroll, benefits and local compliance. Your managers direct the daily work.

items.q: Can the team work US or UK hours?
items.a: Yes. Our Manila and Cebu offices run night shifts for US hours, and the Vietnam offices overlap with UK mornings.

items.q: Which tools can the team use?
items.a: Any tool you already use. Staff are trained on your helpdesk, CRM and accounting software during onboarding.
One monthly fee per full-time person covers salary, benefits, equipment, office and management. We quote per role.
